profile.headline: Embedded SWE Intern @ Plexus | Undergraduate Researcher | CS + DS @ UW-Madison
profile.summary: I love building software because of its leverage; with only a laptop and an internet connection, I can develop tools that reach thousands of users. What keeps me hooked is the feeling of building products that real people actually want. Right now, that's Praxora, the ed-tech startup I co-founded.

positions.title: Co-Founder & Engineer
positions.description: Building the future of medical education.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: I researched emerging AI capabilities across Microsoft Fabric and its enterprise data security implications, sharing my findings through internal user group meetings. I also built a Python tool that monitors capacity across 1,000+ Fabric workspaces to flag inefficient workloads, and researched standardized connection pooling modules to address an incident where zombie connections were taking down apps.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: Cutting-edge physics experiments need software to match. I developed the GUI that controls an innovative electron beam experiment, and built and maintained a full-stack web app that let researchers monitor those experiments remotely.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher, Ehrlich Lab
positions.description: I turn zebrafish behavior into data. I analyze behavioral and neural activity from larval zebrafish experiments, building tools with machine learning libraries like PyTorch and scikit-learn. I help run the experiments from data collection through analysis.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: Critical business areas run on software that has to work. I developed, tested, deployed, and supported in-house and third-party solutions, and collaborated with engineers to build a system that consolidates large volumes of data from many sources into a single centralized repository.

honors.title: Dean's List - Fall 2025
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Wisconsin Madison · Dec 2025

honors.title: Arun Pancholia Scholarship
honors.description: Merit-based scholarship awarded to outstanding undergraduate students in Computer Science and Data Science, recognizing academic achievement, dedication, and active engagement in the university community.
honors.issuer: Issued by Department of Computer Sciences · Jun 2025

volunteerExperiences.description: Prepared and served weekly family-style dinners for the Madison community using locally sourced, seasonal ingredients as part of the Slow Food UW Family Dinner Night program.

Coordinated team logistics by managing transportation, tracking attendance, and maintaining communication with monastery staff to support effective volunteer engagement. Led sustainability and land restoration projects at Holy Wisdom Monastery, including native seed collection, invasive species removal, and maintaining organic garden plots. Also documented team progress through monthly reports, fostering accountability while highlighting ecological impact and community engagement.

projects.title: PersonaXR
projects.description: Allows medical students to practice clinical reasoning and communication with AI-driven patients that respond dynamically rather than following scripted scenarios.

projects.title: Driving Evolution
projects.description: Browser-based simulation of self-driving cars that learn to navigate around obstacles using neural networks and an evolutionary algorithm.
